observations: Absolute scoped MISE_CEILING_PATHS with a nonUTF8 root aborts while decoding settings.
ASCII relative ceiling/trust plus absolute data paths abort in template-context Path serialization.
All-relative data/cache/state/config/global/system paths also abort in template-context Path serialization.
Explicit local mise.toml selection with the same relative paths aborts identically.

primary_sources.behavior: BASE_CONTEXT inserts the actual env::current_dir() Path; Tera rejects its invalid UTF8 serialization.

The installed path is emitted through to_string_lossy(); absolute nonUTF8 paths cannot roundtrip. A hypothetical ASCII relative install path would avoid this particular output loss but the observed relative context aborts before reaching it.
Data/cache/config/state dirs read var_path, which uses var_os and preserves OS paths. The independent template cwd serialization remains an obstacle.

limitations: Does not claim every untested possible alternative is impossible.
No second cache/copy layer, alternate mise build, source change or relaxed isolation was introduced.
